title: Nevada test fallout theory dismissed as baseless

tellings.quote: Yeah, some of the testing in Nevada could have

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property famous for reports of strange events, speaks about the idea that the oddities there could come from weapons testing in Nevada. He allows that some Nevada testing could have played a part, though the story is framed as him rejecting the idea as having no basis.
